title: Soviet paleocontact theories

tellings.quote: Figures like Alexander Kazantsev and Felix Zigel proposed that alien visitors may have influenced early human development,

plain: In the Soviet Union, Michels says, two figures named Alexander Kazantsev and Felix Zigel put forward the idea that alien visitors may have shaped early human development. He tells this himself, without naming where he read it. It matters to his story because it shows the idea of ancient alien contact was taken up on the Soviet side too, not only in the West.
